title: Confirmed Python project
source_request: Build the software described and confirmed by the user.
requirements: Provide automated tests, project documentation, and sat-project.json.

acceptance_criteria.description: The delivered project satisfies the confirmed user outcomes.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Inspect the immutable implementation and tests during independent review.

acceptance_criteria.description: The project supplies a validated setup, start, and test command contract, and its exact start command is directly runnable from the project root without additional arguments or edits.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Run CHECK_PROJECT_CONTRACT, then independently probe the exact start argv with no appended arguments.

acceptance_criteria.description: The project's automated pytest suite is importable from the clean quality workspace and passes through the documented post-setup command.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Run CHECK_PROJECT_TESTS and verify the exact uv run pytest command after setup.

acceptance_criteria.description: The Python source compiles and passes the pinned linter.
The README explains setup, usage, tests, and known limitations and shows the exact setup, start, and test commands from sat-project.json.

constraints: Use the supplied local Python 3.12 execution profile.
Do not require runtime network access or credentials.
Keep sat-project.json setup exactly ["uv", "sync", "--dev"] and test exactly ["uv", "run", "pytest"]; replace only the start placeholder with a project-specific argv beginning ["uv", "run"].

Make the exact start argv directly usable from the project root without extra arguments or configuration edits; a CLI must include a safe default input or interactive flow and a service must start with a complete local configuration.

Keep tests importable when CHECK_PROJECT_TESTS invokes pytest from the clean quality workspace before setup, including explicit pytest pythonpath configuration for a src layout, and also pass the exact post-setup command uv run pytest.
Show the exact setup, start, and test shell commands in README.md; headings such as Installation, Usage, and Testing are valid and do not need the literal words setup or start.
assumptions: This template defines criterion IDs; each product run supplies user-confirmed content.
